We need to find template for Wolff-Kishner reduction retrosynthesis: ketone -> alkane (hydrazine, base). The forward reaction: ketone + hydrazine -> hydrazone (break C=O double bond, form C=N-NH2). Then base eliminates N2 to give alkane (break C=N bond, form C-H). The description says O-H bond of the ketone is broken? Actually ketone has C=O, not O-H. But they say O-H bond broken maybe mis. Anyway functional group broken: ketone. Also maybe functional group formed: alkane? Not in list. We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "ketones". Use correct string "ketones". Also maybe bonds broken: "C=O"? Not sure.
